meta.name: find-skills
meta.description: Helps users discover and install agent skills when they ask questions like "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", "is there a skill that can...", or express interest in extending capabilities. This skill should be used when the user is looking for functionality that might exist as an installable skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现并安装可扩展功能的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想通过安装技能来扩展agent能力但不知从何找起
copy.tagline_en: Discover and install agent skills to extend capabilities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to extend your agent's abilities but don't know which skill to install

howto.what: 当你想做某事但不确定Claude能否直接完成时，它会帮你搜索并推荐可安装的技能包，还能直接帮你安装。
howto.when: 当你问“怎么做X”、“有没有X的技能”或表示想扩展Claude的能力时触发。

say.text: 有没有帮我做代码审查的技能？
say.note: Claude会搜索相关技能并推荐安装。

say.text: 我想找一个能优化React性能的技能。
say.note: Claude会运行搜索命令并展示结果。

howto.what_en: When you ask how to do something or if a skill exists, Claude searches the skills ecosystem and recommends installable skills, optionally installing them for you.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask "how do I do X", "find a skill for X", or express interest in extending capabilities.

say_en.text: Is there a skill for code review?
say_en.note: Claude searches and recommends a skill.

say_en.text: Find a skill to optimize React performance.
say_en.note: Claude runs the find command and shows results.
